thread:
sara-engineering: Kicking off a config-only deploy to canary now. Changes: routing policy -> prefer-low-latency, batch_size 8 -> 6, request_timeout_ms 2000 -> 1800. Canary = 5% traffic for 15m in 16:30-17:30 PT window. Will monitor p95 and error rate. Please ack.

mike-release: Ack. I'll publish the release note snippet and watch the rollout timeline. Add quick rollback steps in thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [3712345678] deploy-started canary=5% config-only user=sara-engineering env=prod-canary

raj: watch the error budget and request saturation on the NLB. If 5xx > 1% or tail latency spikes, hit rollback. Set alert to notify #incidents too.

olivia-product: Heads-up: we'll draft a brief note for any early-adopter customers and exclude enterprise tenants on dedicated pools. No customer-facing changes expected but notify ops if we see anomalies.

tina-sre: Suggested gating: if p95 latency increases by >200ms OR 99th > 1s, abort. Also throttle the canary down to 1% if we see backend saturation. Keep me copied. :rotating_light:

mike-release: Adding pinned model/version is NOT part of this; verifying model hash unchanged. This is purely runtime config. Rollback command (if needed):
```bash
# unpin config -> revert to previous runtime config id
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" https://deploy.redwood.ai/api/v1/configs/revert -d '{"config_id":"previous-config-2026-03-20"}'
```

sara-engineering: Good. Confirmed model hash matches. Monitoring hooks:
- metrics: inference.p95_latency, inference.5xx_rate, requests_per_second
- logs: tail sampler on canary nodes for unexpected OOMs / KV cache misses
Thresholds: p95 > 600ms OR 5xx_rate > 1% = abort.

deploy-bot: [3712345830] canary-progress 5% -> 5% (3m) no-errors

raj: Also watch routing-fallbacks: prefer-low-latency could increase cross-region calls if local pool is constrained. If we see >2% cross-region fallbacks, pause and revert policy.

mike-release: I'll keep the canary at 5% for full 15m. If green, we'll step to 20% for 10m, then 50% and full. Manual gate at 20%.

tina-sre: Quick rollback steps summarized for oncall:
1) Stop canary: `deploy-bot stop-canary 3712345678`
2) Revert config: use the `configs/revert` endpoint (see above)
3) Pin routing to previous policy: `PATCH /runtime/routes` with `policy=balanced`
4) Notify #incidents and paging list.

olivia-product: Thanks. If we hit rollback, I'll prep a customer advisory template.

sara-engineering: Will keep posting checkpoints. If all green after 35m, we'll roll to 100% with a final note.

deploy-bot: [3712345978] canary-complete 15m checks passed -> manual-step required for 20% ramp
